div.div: أُذَانِىٌّ (S, M, Mgh, K) and ↓ آذَنُ (M, K) Largeeared; (S, M, Mgh, K;) long-eared; (M;) applied to a man, (S, M, K,) and to a camel, and to a sheep or goat: (M:) [or] the latter epithet is applied to a ram; and its fem. أَذْنَآءُ to a ewe. (T, S, M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
